THE 10-MINUTE LIFE AUDIT
Northing Studio
Version 1.0

------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT'S INSIDE
------------------------------------------------------------------------

NorthingStudio_10-Minute-Life-Audit_A4.pdf        4 pages, A4 portrait
NorthingStudio_10-Minute-Life-Audit_Letter.pdf    4 pages, US Letter portrait
NorthingStudio_10-Minute-Life-Audit_Tablet.pdf    4 pages, 1620 x 2160 px
licences/                                       font licences (see below)

Four pages, in order:

  1. Start here      - the scope, and the one rule for scoring honestly
  2. The eight areas - eight scores, 0-10, with a line for why
  3. Your wheel      - your eight numbers drawn as one picture
  4. One small move  - the single action you take this week

The A4 and Letter editions are laid out separately. Letter is not a
scaled A4: it is re-flowed for the shorter, wider sheet.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRINTING
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Print at 100% / "Actual size". Do NOT use "Fit to page" or "Shrink to
fit" - that rescales the sheet and the scoring rows will not line up.

  Paper       A4 edition on A4; Letter edition on US Letter
  Sides       single-sided
  Colour      colour or greyscale - both are designed to work
  Ink         ink-light. Measured at 4.2% maximum ink coverage per
              page, so there are no solid fills to drain a cartridge.

Every page prints legibly in pure black and white. The wheel on page 3
uses line weight, not colour, to separate the spokes from the rings.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
ON A TABLET
------------------------------------------------------------------------

The tablet edition is a standard PDF sized 1620 x 2160 px, with internal
page links: each page links forward to the next, and pages 2 to 4 carry
a small "back" chevron to the previous page.

It is intended for handwriting apps that import PDFs and let you
annotate them. Import it as a document, not as a photo, or the links
and the text will be flattened.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT THIS IS, AND WHAT IT IS NOT
------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is a structured self-reflection tool. It is not a diagnosis, an
assessment or therapy. If something here worries you, talk to someone
qualified - that is a strong move, not a weak one.

Page 2 asks how settled you feel about money. That is a question about
how you feel, not advice about your money. This is not financial
advice.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF IT WAS USEFUL
------------------------------------------------------------------------

If this was worth the ten minutes, a rating helps more than you would
think - it is the only reason anyone else finds it.

If you want the rest of the method, The Balance Audit takes all eight
areas further: guided questions so the scores are honest, a gap map,
three standing rules, a 30-day plan, and twelve monthly re-scores.

This free audit is complete as it is. The paid one goes deeper; it does
not unlock this.
